claims.value: 40 DIA FFPE primary-melanoma samples with patient-level age, sex and histologic subtype.
claims.evidence: The publication supplement maps every proteomic identifier to age, sex and melanoma subtype; RAW names encode the same identifiers.

limitations: Ancestry is not assigned because residence and nationality are not ancestry evidence.
The variable-window method has no single supported isolation-window width, so that field remains not available.
